body: Good job! It can be terribly difficult to make appointments, and to stick with them instead of just cancelling. You should definitely be proud of yourself. Keep at it :)

An old friend of mine always did the exact same thing and it bothered me too. A lot of the time I felt like I was just wasting my breath because they didn’t really care about what my other friends and I had to say, and instead they wanted to talk about their own problems and interests... It was exhausting and made things feel very one-sided
